notes: Perpetual free tier under the Hobby workspace plan (except free Postgres, which is a 30-day time-limited instance). Key gotchas: free web services sleep after 15 min idle with ~1 min cold start and lose all filesystem changes; 750 instance hours/month is per workspace, enough for one always-on service; build-pipeline minutes and bandwidth are shared workspace quotas and overage suspends free services if no card is on file. 2026-08-15: Hobby included bandwidth is now 5 GB/month (was 100 GB on 2026-07-03), then $0.15/GB; Hobby workspace is capped at 25 services; Free instance spec (512 MB / 0.1 CPU) is now printed on the official pricing page. No credit card required to sign up (stated on official Render article, 2026).
